Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: Ignored the Planner’s explicit instruction to triangulate Benito Perojo’s birthplace across multiple sources (Britannica, Spanish Wikipedia, Find a Grave, etc.) and repeatedly reopened only IMDb. This failure to gather and compare the requested additional sources prevented resolving the known discrepancy (Madrid vs. Las Palmas) and led to an unverified/possibly incorrect conclusion.
